item.title: Lulla Nagar hsg society, animal lovers spar over feeding spot for stray dogs
item.description: While the feeders want to continue feeding stray dogs and cats in that spot, some residents oppose it and want the spot free of any animals for the “safety” of children and senior citizens.

item.title: CMRS clears additional five stations on Hinjewadi-Shivajinagar Metro corridor
item.description: PMRDA has taken up a ₹426-crore project to provide last-mile connectivity to metro passengers in Hinjewadi.

item.title: MSRTC targets 100% e-fleet by 2037
item.description: The transition will be carried out in phases, with the corporation planning to increase the number of e-buses while reducing its dependence on diesel.

item.title: 10K pink e-rickshaws targeted, only 130 distributed in 2 years
item.description: With an e-rickshaw costing around ₹4 lakh, arranging the beneficiary contribution and securing a bank loan for the balance proved difficult for several applicants.

item.title: Fighting for sports quota, wrestlers grapple with Kurash
item.description: Kurash, an upright jacket-wrestling sport, is particularly similar to wrestling and judo in its emphasis on grip, balance, strength, timing and throwing techniques. This can make the transition comparatively easier for experienced wrestlers.

item.title: Pune mayor seeks Japanese investment during Okayama visit
item.description: The meeting comes as the Pune-Okayama sister-city relationship completes 20 years. Nagpure invited Ibaragi and a business and administrative delegation to Pune in November to mark the milestone.
